review.notes: Full review. Every statement, Check and route recomputed by hand; all fifteen theorems and the two README counts (32632, 27360) reproduced by an independent enumeration over every relation on at most 4 vertices and every simple graph on at most 5 vertices with every structure satisfying the axioms; the axioms compared with simulated depth-first search on the same range. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; no theorem closes under a one-tactic probe; 20 elaborated signatures compared with the README. 31 library declarations opened at the pins. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed. The sampled source locators could not be verified: Erickson's chapter was not obtainable through the sources service and Diestel's preview PDF asks for a password; both are listed as not verifiable and flagged to the human reviewers. One P2 finding: a sentence in 4.2 asserting normal spanning trees for all connected graphs.
